channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: 'No country holds overall hegemony today, world becoming multipolar': Jaishankar at Raisina Dialogue
item.description: At the Raisina Dialogue, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar emphasised the evolving global dynamics, asserting that no single country holds hegemony today. He highlighted the need to move past outdated historical frameworks and recognise the forces shaping a multipolar future.

item.title: Who is Jishnu Dev Varma, new Governor of Maharashtra?
item.description: On Thursday night, Rashtrapati Bhavan appointed Jishnu Dev Varma as the new Governor of Maharashtra amid the ongoing Budget Session that is underway in the state. The appointments were announced through an official statement issued by Rashtrapati Bhavan.

item.title: Yami Gautam defends liking reel questioning Kriti Sanon's Best Actress win; denies PR tactics
item.description: Yami Gautam used Instagram to clarify her liking a reel that questioned Kriti Sanon's Best Actress win at a recent award event. Meanwhile, Kriti Sanon hasn't responded.

item.title: Happy Birthday Janhvi Kapoor: Actor climbs 3,550 steps barefoot to Tirumala Venkateswara Temple
item.description: On her 29th birthday, Bollywood actress Janhvi Kapoor sought blessings at the Tirumala Venkateswara Temple, climbing nearly 3,550 steps barefoot. She wore a simple white kurta-pyjama with floral detailing during the climb and later changed into a pink saree for darshan at the temple.

item.title: No-confidence motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla: constitutional accountability or political theatre?
item.description: Opposition leaders allege that Birla repeatedly denied speaking opportunities to Rahul Gandhi on key national issues such as China border tensions, claims from Manoj Mukund Naravane's memoir, and security concerns involving Narendra Modi.

item.title: Who is Syed Ata Hasnain; Retired Indian Army officer Lt. General appointed Governor of Bihar
item.description: Lt Gen Hasnain served in the Indian Army for nearly four decades and is widely respected for his strategic and administrative capabilities. During his career, he commanded the XV Corps in Jammu and Kashmir, one of the most strategically sensitive formations in the country.

item.title: IDF releases footage of 50 Israeli fighter jets destroying Ali Khamenei's underground bunker: Watch
item.description: The Israel Defense Forces said about 50 fighter jets struck and destroyed an underground bunker linked to Ali Khamenei beneath a leadership compound in Tehran. The facility was built as a secure wartime command centre. Israel said the strike targeted regime infrastructure during the ongoing military campaign against Iran.

item.title: The ammunition paradox: When industrial war returns to precision age
item.description: The Ukraine war revealed massive artillery demand, Ukrainians firing 5,000–8,000 rounds daily, Russians up to 20,000, exceeding pre-2022 production. The U.S., NATO, and allies have boosted artillery and precision missile output, though restoring stockpiles will take years.

item.title: Who is Nand Kishore Yadav; veteran politician appointed Governor of Nagaland
item.description: President Droupadi Murmu on Thursday announced the appointment and transfer of Governors and Lieutenant Governors across several states and Union Territories. As part of the reshuffle, former Bihar Minister and Assembly Speaker Nand Kishore Yadav has been appointed as the Governor of Nagaland.

item.title: RANA NY to celebrate Rajasthan Diwas, Holi Sneh Milan on March 28; Prem Bhandari welcomes new patron members
item.description: The event, taking place at the Consulate General of India in New York, is expected to highlight Rajasthan's rich cultural heritage while strengthening ties among diaspora organizations across the United States.
